summary: Tasks can now have an optional due date. GET /tasks lists open overdue tasks first, then by due date, then by creation time. Past due dates are accepted; completed tasks are never overdue.

changes.what: dueDate on the model and the request types
Validates dueDate as an ISO date
9 new tests: create, update, validation, ordering

checks.notes: Lint and 58 tests passed on the second run (first run: one ordering test failed, fixed).

followUps: Show due dates in the web client
prTitle: Add optional due dates to tasks
